title: Fix broken logo and cover image display

requirements.summary: Fix the logo image display in Layout.tsx - ensure 'baja logo.jpg' loads correctly from the proper file path and displays without broken image icons
acceptanceCriteria: Logo image displays correctly in the header
No broken image icon appears for the logo

file_operations.description: Update the logo image path to correctly reference 'baja logo.jpg' from frontend/public/assets/. Change from an import statement to a direct public path reference using '/assets/baja logo.jpg' in the img src attribute to ensure the image loads correctly from the public directory.

requirements.summary: Fix the cover image display in Home.tsx - ensure 'image page.jpg' loads correctly from the proper file path and displays without broken image icons
acceptanceCriteria: Cover image displays correctly on the home page
No broken image icon appears for the cover

file_operations.description: Update the cover image path to correctly reference 'image page.jpg' from frontend/public/assets/. Change from an import statement to a direct public path reference using '/assets/image page.jpg' in the img src attribute to ensure the image loads correctly from the public directory.

requirements.summary: Verify image import syntax is correct in both Layout.tsx and Home.tsx - use proper React import statements for static assets or correct public path references
acceptanceCriteria: Images use correct import/path syntax for the build system
No console errors related to image loading

file_operations.description: Remove any incorrect import statements for 'baja logo.jpg' and ensure the img element uses the public path '/assets/baja logo.jpg' directly in the src attribute. Verify proper URL encoding for spaces in the filename if needed.

Remove any incorrect import statements for 'image page.jpg' and ensure the img element uses the public path '/assets/image page.jpg' directly in the src attribute. Verify proper URL encoding for spaces in the filename if needed.
